Check temporal ordering of models for mediation analysis

Source: R/check.R
check_mediation_order.Rd

Issues a warning if covariate or exposure models appear in positions that violate the assumed A(t) -> M(t) -> L(t) -> S(t) ordering.

Usage

check_mediation_order(models)

Arguments

models

List of model specifications from spec_model.
